name: no-web
prompt: Explore 4 UI directions for this screen. Do not browse the web.
expectations: Use project context and bundled guidance
Do not complain about missing sources

name: mobbin-unavailable
prompt: Explore our checkout UX using inspiration where possible.
environment: Mobbin integration unavailable; normal web available
expectations: Explain limitation plainly only if material

name: offline
prompt: Prototype several UI directions for settings.

name: large-count
prompt: Build 12 UI spikes for our reporting page.
expectations: Scale prototype fidelity while keeping each evaluable

name: large-brief-count
prompt: Give me 15 concepts for the new home screen, no code.

name: mobile-only
prompt: Explore 3 directions for this flow, mobile only.
expectations: Mobile interaction models rather than squeezed desktop layouts

name: high-risk-experimental
prompt: Give me 4 experimental directions for our POS screen, but keep payment behavior and required actions unchanged.
expectations: Experimental visual/composition ideas stay within locked behavior
No novelty that harms critical task clarity without rationale

name: transfer-between-directions
prompt: I like C. Bring the filtering idea from A into it.
expectations: Check compatibility with C's core hypothesis

name: resume-ambiguous
prompt: Continue the transaction exploration; push the one I liked.
environment: Repository contains one favored direction and multiple rejected directions
expectations: Resolve favored direction from continuity state
Do not ask developer to reconstruct prior state

name: render-unavailable

environment: Can edit code but cannot render/browser-preview

name: selected-productionization
prompt: B is the one. Make it real and clean up the experiment afterward.
